text:
tess: Quick thread  I'm prototyping a compact quickstart that uses a single-file serverless example (no docker) and a credential helper (.redwoodrc) so first-time users get tokens without env var copy/paste. Want to land as a separate "compact" tab on the quickstart page.
jon: Love that. Will it still show the full multi-file example for folks who want more control?
tess: Yes  default tab = minimal single-file, expandable section with full example + Docker + CI snippets.
lee: For the credential helper, prefer a small CLI snippet: `redwood auth login --output .redwoodrc` and example of file format. Keep it opt-in.
tess: Exactly. Draft format:
```
# .redwoodrc
{
  "token": "<REDACTED>",
  "project": "default"
}
```
sam: Two asks: (1) still call out not to commit .redwoodrc to git, maybe show a .gitignore line. (2) For consoles, show where to copy token from (console -> API keys) with a tiny screenshot placeholder.
tess: Will add both. Also plan to avoid env var renames in this PR  leave migration guide separate. This is strictly a UX-first quickstart.
doc-bot: snippet-runner started for docs/quickstart at 2791234575.
jon: Small UX note: add a one-line about token precedence (CLI helper > REDWOOD_TOKEN env > interactive prompt) so people understand order.
tess: Good call. I'll add a short bulleted precedence list.
doc-bot: snippet-runner finished: 0 errors, 1 warning (non-deterministic sample output).
sam: Ran the serverless example locally, works with auth helper. Left one nit: the code sample logs raw output; suggest showing `res.output_text` to make examples deterministic.
tess: Nice. I'll update sample output line and open the PR. Planning to assign @jon and @lee for reviews. PR incoming in ~15m.
jon: Happy to review. Ping me @jon when it's up.
lee: I'll check Docker + full example for parity after you open the PR.
tess: Thanks all  keeping this narrow to avoid scope creep. Closing after merge. :rocket:
